name: Relaxation-based Certificate Definition
description: Instead of explicitly giving the sum formulas for the impossibility certificates in the prose, the problem defines a formal valid schedule and then defines the certificates as the non-existence of a schedule when certain constraints are relaxed. The LLM must deduce that relaxing non-overlap reduces to p1+p2>T, and relaxing sequential dependency reduces to sum(p_c)>T. This removes the direct textual mapping to the algebraic checks.
